label: SevenNet-Nano-4.5
elements: Li, Be, B, C, Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S
notes: The same 105k-parameter SevenNet-Omni student as sevennet-nano-6.0 at the narrowest of its four cutoffs (4.5 A).  Identical weights count and architecture, so the 4.5/6.0 pair isolates receptive-field radius with everything else held fixed.
training_set_note: A distillation student, so it never saw these labels directly: it was trained against the SevenNet-Omni 'mpa' head, whose own corpus is MPtrj + sAlex.  The structure pool used for the distillation is not stated in the release, so the two corpora describe the teacher, not this checkpoint, and no structure count is claimed.

datasets.label: MPtrj
datasets.notes: Materials Project relaxation trajectories, cleaned and subsampled to about every 10th ionic step; created for CHGNet.

datasets.label: sAlex
datasets.notes: Alexandria subsampled by FAIR, filtered to remove prototype overlap with the Matbench Discovery WBM test set.
